versions.content: Timing requirements Type: valid Description: The BSWMD template SHALL allow specifying the timing requirements on functions called in other modules such as callback functions. Rationale: To be able to do timing analysis of Application SW-Components, the BSW needs to define timing requirements additional to the Timing guarantees [RS_BSWMD_00016]. Dependencies: – Use Case: In order to fulfill a given timing guarantee the calls to other functions need to be restricted in time. Supporting Material: –
